home.title: Check smoke-free rules for a location
home.tagline: Clean city. Clear conscience. Check first.
home.subtitle: Search an address or use your location to check nearby no-smoking restrictions. Results are guidance only and do not grant permission.
home.whatIsThis: SmokeCheck SG is a smoking-rules checker, not a smoking-area finder. Search a place to see where smoking is banned — and the nearest official designated smoking area.
home.guideLink: Smoking areas in Singapore: full guide
home.alert: Check before you light up. Smoking is prohibited in many public places. Follow on-site signs and NEA instructions.
home.signageAlert: QR signage mode: this page was opened from a sign or shared map link. Confirm the physical sign at this location before relying on map guidance.
home.guidanceNote: Enter a location to search, or use GPS after browser permission.
home.uncertainBody: If GPS accuracy is poor, no nearby designated area is found, or map data cannot refresh, use manual search and follow official signs, current law, and NEA instructions.
home.mapHelp: Click or tap the map to check a location. Map selections use OneMap reverse geocoding and source-backed SmokeCheck status.
home.zoomNote: Zoom in to see fuller outlines of known prohibited smoking areas and park no-smoking layers.
home.disclaimer: This tool provides guidance based on available map and rule data. Physical signs, current law, and NEA instructions prevail.
home.designatedBody: A designated area may be available nearby, but it is not blanket permission. Confirm the physical sign before smoking.
home.allowedBody: Smoking may be allowed only where current law, premises rules, and on-site signs allow it.
home.signageTitle: When signs conflict with the map
home.signageBody: Follow physical signs, current law, and NEA instructions. Treat this map as planning guidance when a boundary is unclear.
home.reminderPublicPlaces: Bus stops, shelters, covered linkways, queues, and many public buildings commonly have smoking prohibitions.
home.reminderDesignated: Designated smoking areas may exist in some locations, but confirm with physical signage before acting.
home.reminderGuidance: The map is guidance only. Current law, physical signs, and NEA instructions prevail.

rules.title: Rules in plain English
rules.intro: Smoking is prohibited in many public places in Singapore. Use this guide to understand common situations, then follow on-site signs and NEA instructions.
rules.noMatchHint: Try a broader term such as bus stop, park, entrance, Orchard, or designated area.
rules.sourceNote: Source links remain visible because SmokeCheck SG provides guidance, not legal interpretation.
rules.signageConflictNote: If physical signage conflicts with this page, follow signage, current law, and NEA instructions.
rules.guidanceNote: Summarised from public guidance and legislation references. This is guidance, not legal advice.

sources.title: Data sources and disclaimers
sources.intro: Transparency about data provenance, limitations, and privacy.
sources.neaPages: NEA Smoking Prohibition pages and legislation references
sources.dataGovSg: Data.gov.sg open datasets (where available and verifiable at build time)
sources.oneMap: OneMap basemap, search, geocoding, and routing services
sources.prototypeNote: Prototype seed data for designated areas and prohibited zones
sources.disclaimerBody: SmokeCheck SG provides location-based smoking-prohibition guidance using available map and rule data. Physical signage, current law, and NEA instructions always prevail. This is guidance, not legal advice.
sources.privacyBody: Public mode does not require login. Location data is processed client-side and not stored by default. Officer mode uses authenticated sessions for operational workflows only.
limitations: GPS accuracy is an approximation, not legal boundary proof.
Designated-area data may not reflect recent changes in rules or local arrangements.
Data.gov.sg datasets carry their own freshness, accuracy, and licensing terms.
Heatmap and complaint data in officer mode are simulated for prototype use only.
The app does not issue fines, validate identity, or replace enforcement authority.

footer.prototypeNote: Prototype guidance only. Physical signs, current law, and NEA instructions prevail.

sourcesPage.datasetDescription: Current local data includes 52 designated smoking areas, 1 NEA no-smoking-zone feature, 457 NParks no-smoking locations, and clearly labelled simulated municipal feedback heatmaps.

sourcesPage.everyResult: Every guidance result should be traceable back to an official, open-data, or prototype source record.
sourcesPage.usersMustKnow: Users must be aware of technical limits when operating this tool outdoors:
sourcesPage.gpsInaccuracy: GPS inaccuracy: High-rise environments can degrade accuracy. Treat the displayed radius as approximate.
sourcesPage.microGeographies: Micro-geographies: Fine boundaries near bus stops, entrances, shelters, and queues may require physical-sign confirmation.
sourcesPage.temporaryChanges: Temporary changes: Construction, events, or updated signage may not be reflected immediately.
